1. Product Identification and Description
West Item 4432/50 Grey FC is a 20 mm diameter chlorobutyl rubber stopper for injectable drug product vials. The
stopper features a FluroTec® PTFE barrier film on the drug-contact surface and a B2 silicon-based coating on the
machine-contact surface to improve handling and filling line performance.
2. Chemical Composition
Base Elastomer: Chlorobutyl rubber (CIIR), synthetic origin
Curing System: Zinc oxide, stearic acid (no elemental sulfur)
Filler: Carbon black (furnace grade, ASTM N990)
FluroTec Film: Modified PTFE (polytetrafluoroethylene), 100% synthetic
B2-Coating: Dimethicone (polydimethylsiloxane), food/pharma grade
No heavy metals, phthalates, latex, or animal-derived components.
3. Physical Properties
Shore A Hardness: 50 ± 5
Specific Gravity: 1.38 ± 0.05 g/cm³
Operating Temperature: -40°C to +121°C
Autoclave Compatibility: 121°C, 30 min (validated)
Gamma Irradiation: Compatible up to 50 kGy
4. Regulatory Compliance
Complies with USP <381>, EP 3.2.9, JP 7.03, ISO 8362-5, and 21 CFR 177.2600.

Re: AKTA ready Flow Kit Storage Conditions
To Whom It May Concern,
The recommended storage temperature for standard AKTA ready flow kits is provided in Section 8.3 of the Operating
Instructions 28960345 and specified as > +5°C. This recommendation also applies to all modified AKTA ready flow kits
as well, including the two listed in the below table. Extended storage below the recommended +5°C could lead to
brittleness or cracking of the plastic connectors. However, the operating temperature of AKTA ready flow kits is +2°C to
+40°C. If the kits are allowed to acclimate to a warmer temperature before being used this would reduce the risk of
damage to the kit during setup and handling.
